## Checklist

- [ ] The entry follows the format: `- [Name](https://official-url) — One factual sentence.`
- [ ] The link points to the canonical official URL and works (no 404, no redirect loop).
- [ ] The URL has no affiliate, tracking, or UTM parameters.
- [ ] The description is one neutral sentence: starts with a capital letter, ends with a period, no marketing language or superlatives.
- [ ] The entry is placed in the correct section.
- [ ] The entry is in alphabetical order within its section.
- [ ] The tool is not already listed (no duplicate name or link).
- [ ] The tool is a real, publicly available AI website builder.
